newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia bourse moves higher, Uhispank active.
newsitem.headline: Estonia bourse moves higher, Uhispank active.

text.p: Trade on the Estonian bourse picked up slightly on Wednesday and dealers said that although the unexpected activity was welcome it was not expected to hold over into tomorrow in the absence of fresh market-moving news.
Total trade on the main list was 31.9 million kroons with the Talse 1.05 percent stronger at 249.11.
"The upward movement today was unexpected and without any reason, however it seems to be a one-off thing with no clear sign that it will continue tomorrow," one dealer said.
Uhispank was most active stock with one large block going through to push the turnover higher for a total turnover of 14.3 million kroons to close 1.50 kroons higher at 51.40 kroons.
Hansapank rebounded from yesterday's fall to close 2.15 kroons higher to end on 127.65 kroons after a 12.7 million kroons changed hands.
"The level of trade in Hansapank was unexpected but it is not expected to be repeated again tomorrow as there little to excite investors further at present," another broker said.
The free market turned over 6.2 million kroons with most stocks drifting lower.
Privatisation vouchers were most traded with 3.8 million kroons moved. The vouchers closed at 0.283 kroons, down 0.01 kroons from Tuesday.
